how_its_made:

by bootstrapping two anvil servers we can continuously integrate live data from two chains, further proving the dual chain mechanisms rather than a cached server. then by generating the confirmation bundle to be executed onchain then we execute, then verify, then additonally can verify if tampering was done via a challenge mechanism calling older blocks without our own offchain cache, which leads to callback onchain
